verdict.rationale: Rootly's docs say incidents can be declared, run, and resolved from Slack, Google Chat, and Microsoft Teams. Workflows create the incident channel in Slack or Teams and keep stakeholders updated, and the Slack AI can change severity and page teams. However, nothing in the evidence shows incident roles being assigned or created automatically from chat, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented automatic role assignment, independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow in Slack and Teams.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can declare and run an incident from chat — Slack or Teams — with channels, roles, and updates created for me
